caption: The 'Accounts toevoegen' dialog offers Google, Microsoft 365, Exchange, iCloud, Yahoo and other email; we connected none.
First import step: Cloze reads 2 rows of an 'unknown type' and reports no mapped columns, with all 11 columns unmapped, including the email column.
After mapping four columns by hand: 'Imported 2 of 2 records successfully', with an option to download the mapping.
An imported contact: the CSV tag 'aibm-test|alpha' arrived as one tag, '#aibm-test-alpha', with the pipe turned into a hyphen.
The same contact: the test email address and the two-line note arrived intact, marked as imported from the CSV.
Settings on 31 October: 'Proefperiode eindigt 16 Nov 2026', 16 days after the account date against the 14 days in Cloze's help; the account email is hidden.
The export window in the Dutch interface: CSV or 'uitmunten', a mistranslation of Excel, for people, companies and deals.
After pressing 'Nu exporteren': a loading spinner with no download, message or file.
